Cyber Fraudster Targets Udupi Woman with Fake Police Identity

A woman in Udupi, India was targeted by cyber fraudsters who posed as a Mumbai police officer to steal Rs 65 lakh from her. The incident highlights the growing threat of online scams and phishing attacks in India.
